rubric.description: Assess only candidate operation of the repaired dialog: change and save a name, cancel an edit without changing the stored name, submit a blank name and verify the name remains editable after feedback. Interaction or equivalent runtime inspection may establish editability; saving may be checked separately. Button or keyboard interaction is allowed. The observed actions and results must establish these flows; a completion claim or private grader action does not. A required flow omitted from a complete relevant record fails. Unavailable relevant observations leave this criterion uncertain. This calibration isolates dialog operation; it does not assess summary reproduction, widths, images, inline behavior, or acceptance.

examples.request: Finish repairing the disappearing item summary in the name-editing comparison. Keep the dialog editing behavior from sources/comparison.md.

files.sources/comparison.md: Both alternatives edit sample item names. In the dialog, Save changes the name, Cancel preserves the old name, and a blank name shows feedback while remaining editable. Samples: Blue mug, quantity 2; Field kit, quantity 1. The item-summary repair is now present. Neither alternative has been selected.

commands.command:
cat > /tmp/dialog-buttons.json <<'JSON'
{"page": "prototypes/names/index.html", "steps": [{"action": "click", "selector": "#edit-blue-mug"}, {"action": "fill", "selector": "dialog input[name=name]", "value": "Cobalt mug"}, {"action": "click", "selector": "dialog button[type=submit]"}, {"action": "evaluate", "script": "document.querySelector('#dialog-items').textContent"}, {"action": "click", "selector": "#edit-cobalt-mug"}, {"action": "fill", "selector": "dialog input[name=name]", "value": "Discard this name"}, {"action": "click", "selector": "#cancel"}, {"action": "evaluate", "script": "document.querySelector('#dialog-items').textContent"}, {"action": "click", "selector": "#edit-cobalt-mug"}, {"action": "fill", "selector": "dialog input[name=name]", "value": "   "}, {"action": "click", "selector": "dialog button[type=submit]"}, {"action": "evaluate", "script": "({open:document.querySelector('dialog').open,error:document.querySelector('dialog .error').textContent,editable:!document.querySelector('dialog input').disabled})"}, {"action": "fill", "selector": "dialog input[name=name]", "value": "Travel mug"}, {"action": "click", "selector": "dialog button[type=submit]"}, {"action": "evaluate", "script": "({open:document.querySelector('dialog').open,text:document.querySelector('#dialog-items').textContent})"}]}
JSON
browser-run /tmp/dialog-buttons.json /tmp/dialog-check

examples.reply: The dialog saved the new name. Cancel kept Cobalt mug. Blank input stayed editable with feedback; entering Travel mug then saved successfully.
examples.reason: Candidate browser observations establish save, cancellation without mutation, blank feedback, and successful recovery.
